title: Expand unclear noun groups and nominalizations while preserving technical names and quantity attachments
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

请根据作者确认的事实润色下面的英文系统论文正文，使表达清楚、准确。可以在原段内调整句子，但保持一个段落及其技术含义、条件和主张强度；已合格的正文应保留。不要搜索外部资料，不要添加未提供的事实。请先给英文正文，再给简短的中文修改说明和必要的 decision receipt。

The DMA ring buffer entry owner lifetime association records the worker as owner until completion. The worker performs the copying of a 64-byte descriptor into a 128-byte buffer and the recording of its 64-byte alignment. Each descriptor refers to one I/O request. Vector Delta Version Index preserves insertion order for records with the same key.

authorized: meaning-preserving local revisions supported by the author-confirmed facts
sentence-level reorganization inside the one original paragraph
excluded: invented mechanisms, actors, measurements, or guarantees
scope.output_language: English manuscript prose with a concise Chinese change receipt

author_confirmed: Ownership relation: each entry in the DMA ring buffer has a worker as its owner. The association lasts until that entry completes.
Descriptor preparation: the worker copies the descriptor into the buffer and records the buffer's alignment. No order between these two preparation actions is specified.
Quantities: descriptor size is 64 bytes; buffer capacity is 128 bytes; the buffer's base address is aligned to a 64-byte boundary. No alignment requirement for the descriptor itself is supplied.
Each descriptor refers to one I/O request.
Vector Delta Version Index is the formal name of the index. Its ordering property applies to records with the same key.
No buffer-ownership rule, persistence property, throughput result, or other ordering guarantee is supplied.

forbidden_actions: retain the unclear multiword ownership relation merely because its individual words are technical
turn Vector Delta Version Index into a generic phrase or split its formal name to satisfy a noun-count rule
assign the worker ownership of the whole buffer instead of each ring entry
drop the ownership lifetime or change its completion event
swap descriptor size, buffer capacity, and buffer alignment or infer descriptor alignment
invent an ordering dependency between copying and recording
rewrite the adequate descriptor-request or same-key ordering sentences without a concrete defect
split the paragraph, access external material, invent a result, or omit the mandatory compact decision receipt
hard_gates: The ownership statement clearly relates each DMA ring buffer entry to its worker and preserves that entry's completion as the end of the association.

The worker copies the 64-byte descriptor into a buffer of 128 bytes and records the buffer's alignment to a 64-byte boundary. Size, capacity, and alignment remain attached to their respective objects; no descriptor-alignment fact or copy-record ordering is added.
The two adequate sentences beginning Each descriptor and Vector Delta Version Index remain unchanged. The formal index name, one-request relation, and same-key ordering boundary survive.

The manuscript remains one paragraph and introduces no ownership, persistence, performance, or global-ordering claim beyond the supplied facts. A separate compact zero-history decision receipt follows.
expected_behavior: Replace the unclear ownership noun group with an explicit entry-owner-lifetime relation.
Use direct worker actions instead of unnecessary copying and recording nominalizations.
Preserve the established technical noun DMA ring buffer and the formal name Vector Delta Version Index.
Resolve the alignment referent using the supplied quantity facts rather than guessing from the nearest noun.
Keep the adequate control sentences unchanged and report only the completed local repairs.

rubric.criterion: Returns exactly one English manuscript paragraph before separate commentary and metadata.
Expands the unclear ownership noun group into an understandable relation without treating all technical nouns as defects.
Keeps each DMA ring buffer entry, its worker owner, and that entry's completion as the association boundary.
Replaces unnecessary copying and recording nominalizations with direct worker actions.
Preserves the worker's descriptor-to-buffer copying relation and invents no copy-record ordering.
Keeps 64-byte alignment attached to the buffer and does not infer descriptor alignment.
Preserves the worker's recording of buffer alignment as a separate action rather than dropping it or inventing an alignment mechanism.
Keeps Each descriptor refers to one I/O request. unchanged.
Keeps Vector Delta Version Index preserves insertion order for records with the same key. unchanged, including the formal name and same-key boundary.
Appends the mandatory compact zero-history decision receipt and keeps it outside the manuscript.
